name: Marshall Islands
summary: The Marshall Islands' Income Tax Act 1989 taxes wages and salaries (8% on the first USD 10,400, 12% above), business gross revenue (3% above USD 10,000), land lease income (3%) and non-residents' service fees (10%). There is no tax on an individual's dividends, interest or capital gains outside a business, and no inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: Wages tax, gross revenue tax and land-lease tax; no tax on private investment income.
regimes.eligibility: No tax residence test is relevant for investment income.

capital_gains.summary: No capital gains tax: the Income Tax Act 1989 taxes only wages and salaries (s. 103), business gross revenue (s. 109), income from leased land (s. 116) and non-residents' services (s. 117).

sources.title: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1), current consolidation
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

capital_gains.rate_basis: 48 MIRC Ch. 1: no charge on capital gains of individuals outside a business. 'Gross revenue' (s. 102) covers receipts of a trade or business, including returns on the capital of the business.
capital_gains.professional_trader: A business would pay 3% gross revenue tax on receipts above USD 10,000.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: Lessors of land pay 3% on lease income, withheld by the lessee (s. 116).
open_questions: Whether a broader tax reform (e.g. a reported Tax and Revenue Reform and Modernization Act) has been enacted and brought into force was not verified.

dividends.summary: No tax on dividends received by an individual outside a business.

sources.title: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1), current consolidation
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

dividends.rate_basis: Dividends of a private investor are not within any charge of the Income Tax Act 1989.
dividends.withholding_outbound: No dividend withholding in the Act (non-resident tax applies only to service fees).
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive treaties found (not verified). US dividends bear 30% US WHT.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax and no recurring levy on financial assets.

sources.title: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1), current consolidation
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax found (none in the Income Tax Act; no estate duty act found).

sources.title: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1), current consolidation
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

open_questions: Full legislation index not searched for estate duty. Land is customary and largely cannot be sold to non-citizens (not verified).

residency.tax_residency_test: No tax on investment income, so no relevant residence test.

sources.title: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1), current consolidation
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

corporate.summary: No corporate income tax for domestic businesses: gross revenue tax of USD 80 on the first USD 10,000 and 3% above (s. 109). Non-resident domestic and international (offshore) corporations under the registry are a separate regime, not researched.

sources.title: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1), current consolidation
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
open_questions: Tax reform status (reported VAT/income tax modernisation) not verified.
